repo: example API (Keycloak + OpenAPI) — a synthetic manifest showing the finished shape
note: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. Operator manifests for real targets are private records in monitor/private/bola/<name>.json (CW_BOLA_MANIFEST_DIR overrides), because a manifest names the target's realm, accounts and endpoints. Two tenants (A/B), each with a user and an admin, plus anon. Tokens are minted by Keycloak password grant; the passwords arrive through the named env vars at invocation, never inline. Ownership is SEEDED: each actor creates an object and the peers probe cross-reads. base is left unset — pass --base or export CW_TARGET_URL so this never invents a target.
